description: The bar chart illustrates the GPU memory usage in gigabytes (GB) for different fine-tuning approaches when applied to a language model. The vertical axis represents the GPU memory in GB, and the horizontal axis lists the fine-tuning methods. The chart includes seven bars, each representing a different method: Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, LORA, QLoRA, and a method labeled "Ours." The Full FT method uses the most memory, with a value close to 60 GB, while the "Ours" method uses the least, around 20 GB. The bars are colored in shades of orange, except for the "Ours" method, which is green. The values for each method are not explicitly labeled, but the "Ours" method is the shortest bar, indicating the lowest memory usage, and the Full FT method is the tallest, indicating the highest memory usage. The chart does not provide any information on the order of the methods or any visual emphasis on specific bars.
